name: Historic Fortified Town of Campeche
description: Campeche is a Spanish colonial port on Mexico's Gulf coast, founded in 1540 on the site of the Maya town of Can Pech. Its historic centre is still ringed by stone walls and bastions, built to keep pirates and buccaneers out. Inside, you can stroll streets of well-preserved colonial buildings, while the old Maya barrios outside the walls keep their original churches.
